verdict.rationale: Algolia stores a copy of customer data in hosted indices (algolia-docs-54). The Search API and CLI are documented as tools to 'manage your indices and records' (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-50), which implies record and index deletion, but no doc explicitly describes deletion or retention controls. Agent Studio caches completions by default (algolia-docs-24), and nothing says how long that cache or analytics data is kept or how to purge it. Missing for 10: explicit delete-record/delete-index documentation, configurable retention periods for analytics/events and cached LLM completions, data-deletion/GDPR erasure workflows, independent corroboration.
